parts.gloss: those who do not know how

words.gloss: those who do not know how

literal: Dividingly speaking, friends they will separate, pleasantly speaking, friendship cultivating, those who do not know how.
translation: Those who do not know how to cultivate friendship by speaking pleasantly will speak divisively and alienate even their own friends.
modern: இனிமையாகப் பேசி நட்பை வளர்க்கத் தெரியாதவர்கள், பிரிவினை உண்டாக்கும்படிப் பேசித் தம் நண்பர்களையும் பிரித்துவிடுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts two ways of speaking and their effects on relationships. Those who do not know how to nurture friendships by speaking pleasantly and joyfully (நகச்சொல்லி) end up doing the opposite. By speaking behind people's backs or carrying tales, they create discord (பகச்சொல்லி) and alienate even their closest companions (கேளிர்). The poet highlights that the inability to speak kindly and constructively inevitably leads to the destruction of one's own social circle.
